sloka: इति प्रतिसमादिश्य पुत्रौ सीतां तथा स्नुषाम् ।इन्द्रलोकं विमानेन ययौ दशरथो ज्वलन् ।। ६.१२२.३७ ।।
transliteration: iti pratisamādiśya putrau sītāṁ tathā snuṣām ।indralokaṁ vimānena yayau daśaratho jvalan ।। 6.122.37 ।।

translations.english: "You need not be told about the service to your husband. Nevertheless, I am giving instruction. This Rama is supreme god for you."
